templates.name: Zone Compare
templates.description: Two filled comparison columns with a clear lower caption band. Best for explaining paired rules, areas, or before-after systems without an empty center.

templates.name: Kit Grid
templates.description: A compact 2x2 tile grid with strong item blocks and a clear lower caption band. Best for packing lists, saveable checklists, and small sets of essentials.

templates.name: Editorial Box
templates.description: A strong framed card with headline, subhead, and list rows. Best for definitions or summary moments.

templates.name: Kinetic Steps
templates.description: Floating step pills without a full card box. Best for process, how-to, or quick-start narration.

templates.name: Menu Board
templates.description: A menu/signboard style with sliding rows. Best for food, product lists, or options.

templates.name: Radial Burst
templates.description: A center headline with orbiting/angled labels. Best for explaining several meanings in one concept.

templates.name: Split Checklist
templates.description: A vertical guide rail with checklist items. Best for etiquette, travel tips, and warnings.

templates.name: Convenience Tray
templates.description: A bright shelf/tray grid with large item blocks. Best for convenience-store, breakfast, shopping, or assembled-choice scenes.

templates.name: Morning Route
templates.description: A vertical path with paired start/end labels. Best for route, sequence, commute, or before-after logic.

templates.name: Wrapper Tabs
templates.description: A package/wrapper metaphor with tagged steps. Best for food wrappers, assembly, folding, or object-anatomy scenes.

templates.name: Receipt Stack
templates.description: A paper receipt/card stack with item rows and barcode texture. Best for prices, purchases, rules, and quick tallies.

templates.name: Stamp Stack
templates.description: Layered stamped slips with angled labels and a verification badge. Best for local rules, validations, myths, and cultural checkpoints.
